Now you might say that to practice English daily, we need to do an online course, get a degree, spend a lot of money, and we don't have that much money at home. Brother, the method we are going to tell you won't cost that much. You only have to do one thing: download the Seekho app. Now you'll ask, what is this Seekho app? Seekho app has an AI coach to teach you English. First, you need to learn English words like yes, no, what is 'I', 'am', 'was', 'were', and then learn to make sentences like 'I am going to the market'. Then learn to make bigger sentences like 'Today I am going to the market to buy vegetables'. You will learn everything on the Seekho app. What do you have to do? Stop tapping on your phone all day, watching reels, laughing, liking, and sharing. Delete Instagram from your phone and download the Seekho app. Just give 15 minutes daily, and in one month, your English will become like Virat's, okay? If you want to learn English, you must practice daily, and the ultimate solution for that is the Seekho app.]
